# Swanada (स्वनद) — In-Browser 16 kHz Multilingual Speech-to-Text

> Sub-second client-side streaming & batch speech-to-text for Classical Sanskrit (`sa`), Indian English (`en`), and 10 Indic languages (`hi`, `kn`, `mr`, `bn`, `ta`, `te`, `ml`, `gu`, `pa`, `or`) powered by INT8 Conformer-CTC ONNX + WebAssembly SIMD with zero server dependencies.

- Live Studio: https://hemanth.github.io/swanada/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/hemanth/swanada
- Model Weights & Vocabularies: https://huggingface.co/gnumanth/swanada

## Supported Languages (12)
- `sa` — Classical Sanskrit (Devanagari + deterministic Roman IAST transliteration)
- `en` — Indian English
- `hi` — Hindi
- `kn` — Kannada
- `mr` — Marathi
- `bn` — Bengali
- `ta` — Tamil
- `te` — Telugu
- `ml` — Malayalam
- `gu` — Gujarati
- `pa` — Punjabi
- `or` — Odia

## Key Capabilities
- Capability-routed Dual-Tier Acoustic Architecture:
  - **Mobile Tier (`< 30 MB`)**: Shared `25.4 MiB` (`26.6 MB`) INT8 Conformer-Small encoder (`swanada_mobile_ctc_int8.onnx`) + twelve `515 KB` linear CTC heads (`heads_mobile/<lang>.bin`) — `5.0x` faster single-thread WASM SIMD on phones and fits inside iOS Safari's `~50 MB` `CacheStorage` quota across all 12 languages.
  - **Studio Tier (Desktop)**: Shared `177.4 MiB` INT8 Conformer-Large encoder (`sushrota_sanskrit_ctc_int8.onnx`) + twelve `515 KB` linear CTC heads (`heads/<lang>.bin`).
- Real-time in-browser streaming via `AudioWorklet` (anti-aliased 16 kHz resampling) + `Web Worker` (`onnxruntime-web` WASM SIMD) with two-zone (`committed` + `volatile`) prefix-locked CTC decoding (`0.00%` pause churn).
- Offline persistence via browser `CacheStorage` + `IndexedDB` (`swanada-onnx-v1.0.0`).
- Multi-runtime API parity across Browser ESM, Node.js CJS/ESM, Python (`swanada`), and CLI (`swanada --tier mobile|studio|auto`).
